stories.title: Coleg Cambria wins Connah’s Quay pitch appeal as planning inspector overturns Flintshire refusal
stories.summary: Coleg Cambria has won its appeal against Flintshire County Council’s refusal of planning permission for an all-weather football pitch at its Deeside campus on Kelsterton Road, Connah’s Quay. stories.title: Flintshire schools and teachers urged to enter Chester Zoo’s National Education Awards
stories.summary: Chester Zoo is calling for nominations from Flintshire, Wrexham and Denbighshire schools and teachers for its National Education Awards, with entries open until 17 May. stories.title: Planning inspectors press Uniper on flood and CO2 plans for new Connah’s Quay power station
stories.summary: Planning inspectors examining Uniper UK’s proposed Connah’s Quay Low Carbon Power Project have issued a second round of written questions on flood risk, sewage, accidental CO2 release and saltmarsh. stories.title: Connah’s Quay High School students complete two-day work experience at Toyota Deeside
stories.summary: Twenty-eight Year 10 students from Connah’s Quay High School have completed a two-day engineering work experience programme at Toyota Engine Plant Deeside. The pupils took part in Toyota’s TWEX scheme, which gives secondary school students access to the manufacturing site to work on problem-solving, team and leadership tasks. stories.title: Missing Connah’s Quay man found safe after multi-agency Dee search
stories.summary: A man reported missing from his home in Connah’s Quay was found safe on Tuesday evening after a three-hour multi-agency search of the Dee estuary and surrounding inland areas.
